title: Square Word: Summer Edition☀️
description:
It's so hot outside, let's cool a little!SQUARE WORD is now available on Steam with the SUMMER EDITION!
COCO, the funny parrot, will be your guide in this new edition! Chill and relax!

 Four summer themes: Beach - Vacation - Camping - Ocean
 140+ words to find.
 Handcrafted grids, I tried to make words association in the grid.
 Daily challenge.
 4 difficulties (easy to very hard).
 Difficulty increasing gradually.
 Letter & word hints.
 Collect Stamps with extra objectives and receive rewards!
 New Feature: Draw a line when you connect letters!
 Additional songs.
description_short: Square Word is coming on Steam! Discover 140+ words spread in 4 sunny themes! Handcrafted grids, hints, mini-objectives & more!
